findings.highlight: "Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「はい、御代わりですね！　いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
findings.governingReading: Sakura made plenty and encourages Shirou to eat a lot.
findings.explanation: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.

findings.highlight: I'm already the only one blushing, so I can't let every single thing Sakura does throw me for a loop.
findings.evidenceJa: 一人で顔を赤くしてるのも我慢するし、桜の一挙一動に目がいってしまうのも言い訳しない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou accepts his involuntary attention to Sakura and will not make excuses for it.
findings.explanation: Shirou's acceptance of his wandering attention becomes an effort not to be flustered. The change concerns his handling of attraction.
